notes.title: 0.5.1 (April 1st) Update
notes.content:
Happy April 1st! We hope you will enjoy the new feature gamemode, Anti-Chess!

Here are more details about the update:
+ [NEW MODE] Anti-Chess
~ Fix defunct 2D/3D toggle being visible in Cube Chess
~ Fix crash with new AI in Cube Chess
~ Other minor UI and Bugfixes

notes.title: 0.5.0 Update
notes.content:
This is the first major update for Non-Euclidean Chess!

For the past few months, we have focused on adding more options, more pieces, and more gamemodes.

Changelog:
+ [NEW MODE] Compound Chess
+ [NEW MODE] Ising chess
+ New Themes: Lava, Porcelain, and other secret textures ;)
+ Revamped 3D models and 2D piece icons
+ Promotion options - does not default to Queen
+ Anti-pawn piece (it un-promotes!)
+ Piece movement visualization
+ Lighting Slider
~ AI Overhaul
~ UI Tweaks & Improvements
- Removed Slider Chess AI bug

Plus many minor bugfixes, and probably a few new bugs for extra proteins. Have fun! :)
